name: chatModel
description: Creates a stateless chat model connected to an LLM provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Gemini, Azure OpenAI or Ollama. Use its chat() method to send a prompt.

params.name: config
params.description: Struct with provider and modelName (required), plus apiKey, baseUrl, temperature, maxTokens, timeout and other provider-specific options.
